legend: Diffuse infiltration of cervical stroma by tubulocystic glands lined by cells with abundant clear cytoplasm, enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei and occasional nucleoli with minimal mitotic activity.

The tumour is composed of mixed solid and tubulocystic patterns. Cells have abundant clear to eosinophilic cytoplasm, large, round nuclei with prominent nucleoli, little mitotic activity. Tubules are lined by a single layer of similar cells with hobnailing.
